messages:
tara: Heads-up — I noticed a surprising uptick in quota-attribution noise for customer acme. Traced it to the python SDK release (v2.4.0) where `include_affinity_meta` defaulted to true.
nik: Ack. Which header is it emitting now?
liz: It adds `X-RWD-AFFINITY: region=us-east;route=lowcost` and `X-RWD-COST_CENTER: team-xyz` in the same request. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1422
sam: Customers are seeing billing spikes because console splits by cost center and then our routing heuristic re-maps affinity to a different bucket. Can we hotfix the SDK default back to false?
liz: Yeah — my intent was convenience, but that was the wrong default. I'll cut a patch (v2.4.1) and make it opt-in. Example request I'm seeing:
```
POST /v1/generate
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer <token>
  X-RWD-AFFINITY: region=us-east;route=lowcost
  X-RWD-COST_CENTER: team-xyz
```
simon: @liz patch sounds right. Console-side we should treat affinity purely as a routing hint and ignore it for quota attribution unless `X-RWD-COST_CENTER` is present. I'll open a guard PR.
tara: Good plan. Also please add telemetry so we can quantify how many requests include both headers vs only affinity. Need to know blast radius.
nik: On telemetry: add a sampled counter `sdk.headers_presence` with enum values ["none","affinity","cost_center","both"]. Start sampling at 1%. That will let billing + routing teams measure impact without heavy cardinality.
liz: Plan for release: cut v2.4.1 with default=false, publish canary tag, deploy to staging, run smoke — then prod. Any objections?
sam: No objections, but please add a console banner and an incident note for impacted customers during the rollback window.
ops-bot: deploy to staging started by liz — job #7782
deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded (staging, sdk:v2.4.1-canary)
tara: Ran synthetic smoke against staging — quota attribution normalized, no spike in cost-center buckets. Monitoring charts look stable.
nik: I'll land console guard: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/887 — gating via hidden flag `attr_compat_v2` for 48h. If safe, remove flag.
liz: Thanks. Post-rollout follow-ups: (1) add SDK config name `enable_metadata_enrichment` (opt-in), (2) document changelog + migration steps, (3) prepare a short customer comms template.
sam: I'll draft the comms and add a devex note. 
liz: Patch PR created and CI green — will tag release after tests: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1430
tara: Great work. Assigned follow-ups: telemetry counter (nik), console guard + flag (simon), customer comms + devex doc (sam), SDK patch + changelog (liz). I'll open a tracking ticket in backlog and follow up on verification in 24h. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
